label: The Queen and Her Companion: B

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... I have imparted all the substance of my knowledge.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The rest I leave in thy hands.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: All materials have been received. I thank you for your cooperation.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: If you do not mind, could you explain the source of this information?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... 'Tis the long held wish of V.T.C.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Are you from V.T.C.?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Ay, I was one among a band of technologically fitted Nikkes named the Profound.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Knowest thou of the Mechanical Messiah Project?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It was a project in which the AI Eva took control of Raptures 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, and 07, known as the Seven Arbiters,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: in an attempt to restore the planet.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... Thou knowest the matter well. I confess I expected otherwise.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Ark and I were created in that same era.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I was originally devised as a countermeasure to the AI Eva,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: and the Ark was constructed as a place for my education.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Humanity recognized the danger of the AI Eva at an early stage.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... Indeed. 'Twas too early for mankind to possess such a thing.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Could you explain the connection between the materials you delivered and the Mechanical Messiah Project?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... V.T.C. accepted not of the Mechanical Messiah.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: They believed that to commend the future to an abhorred AI... I pray thee, forgive me this slander. 'Tis their words, not mine own.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: No need to apologize. Please continue.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The thought that an AI should be committed the future sat ill with them. In their eyes, there could be but one savior.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The one they called Her Holiness.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Thus did they devise a means of destruction for the AI Eva.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Vapaus, the nanomachine killer.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Ay. As Eva had a humanoid body made of nanomachines, 'twas a stratagem most appropriate.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: After great tribulation, they did create Vapaus, in the form of blood.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Was there a special reason to develop it in that form?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Methinks they desired to contrive a scene wherein nothing but the blood of Her Holiness, the true messiah, might vanquish the vile Mechanical Messiah.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: How extremely inefficient.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: I do agree.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Divers clinical trials followed the creation of Vapaus to administer the substance to Her Holiness.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: In the midst thereof, trouble did arise.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You are referring to the incident in which Eva fused with Doctor Alva, the project's chief director, and became the Queen.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Recognizing the threat of the Queen, the United Forces of Humanity attacked the Space Station,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: but humanity was driven to the brink of annihilation by the new weapons the Queen created: Raptures.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: 'Tis so, now called the 1st Rapture Invasion.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: At that time, the records of Vapaus were utterly lost, nothing remaining.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Do you believe that was due to interference from the Queen?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Without doubt, for none else could destroy the records so wholly.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Thus was Vapaus lost even to V.T.C.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Yet, there must needs be a bearer of Vapaus somewhere.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The clinical trials were of a scale most prodigious.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Though many did perish, those of an extraordinary nature must have survived.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: I implore thee, find a Vapaus bearer.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: For what reason?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: For the eternal destruction of the Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: There is a kind of gene called the Queen Gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The Seven Arbiters doth bestow it upon Raptures of great might.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: If there be a Queen already, no Queen Gene shall be bestowed, for there can be but one Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: However, the Queen is not now found upon the surface. She wanders beyond the sky.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: At this present, there is one who seeketh to create a new Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: She hath intent to make a Rapture of such might to be worthy of the Queen Gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: But 'tis no light endeavor, by reason of the Gene Reaper.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Neither is her conversation with Raptures without vexation.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... She hath desire to create a puppet of a Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: And so, her eyes hath settled upon Nikkes.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Already hath many fallen into her hands, and some became Heretics.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The Queen Gene appeared not in most, whom were thereafter slain.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Those in whom it appeared met their end at the hands of the Gene Reaper.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Yet in due course she shall succeed, for she is more than equal to the endeavor.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Herein lies the need of a Vapaus bearer.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The origin of the Queen hath its roots in loneliness.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: She therefore seeketh one to supply her lack.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Whoso becometh her companion shall be granted a gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The one with this gene bestowed attains transcendent regenerative abilities and physical capabilities.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Perchance she conferreth this gene to the end that they may abide together all their days.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Do you have any knowledge of the origin of that ability?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... Nay. NIMPH, cores... This world abounds with matters I comprehend not.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: But, to the matter, prithee find a Vapaus bearer to make into one that may fill the loneliness of the unborn Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: By any means.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: To speak plainly, Young Lady Enikk,

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: thou needest find a Nikke of great might and potential to become a Queen,

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: and pair her with a Vapaus bearer.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You want her to give the gene to the bearer of Vapaus.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: 'Tis so.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: To what end?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: For their mutual destruction.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Mutual destruction.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The Vapaus of a gene bearer doth react violently to the Queen Gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: So soon as their touches meet, the Vapaus will activate and attack the bearer of the Queen Gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Such is its nature, for it was created to slay the Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Should that come to pass...

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Both Queen and companion will be brought to ruin.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: From thenceforth, never shall a Queen be born again upon the surface.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The Queen shall lose her corporeal form entirely, and naught but her gene shall remain.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: The Seven Arbiters shall take this to mean the Queen is yet found on the surface, and will bestow the Queen Gene no more.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: What becomes of the bearer of the gene and Vapaus?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... I believe the Vapaus within the body shall all be spent, and the bearer shall perish.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Wherefore did Her Holiness receive not the Vapaus, and a multitude of clinical trials were conducted.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: However, the technology was lost unto them before their labors bore fruit.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I have a point of contention.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: By my calculations, Vapaus can be made to react with the Queen Gene without the need for a companion gene.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Your requirements are more stringent than is necessary.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: Newly born though she may be, a Queen is yet a Queen. To approach by ordinary means would prove a thing most difficult.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: However, should it be her companion...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Approaching the Queen becomes easy.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It is an abhorrent strategy that toys with both body and heart.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... I shall do whatsoever is needful to prevail.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I have one question.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: What is the source of all of this information?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... I have beheld it with mine own eyes, and that more than once.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I interpret that to mean you aligned with the one trying to create a Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... Ay. We are laboring together to create a Queen.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I see. I understand your message.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Allow me to summarize this information.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: A Queen arises when the Seven Arbiters grant a Rapture the Queen Gene.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: At the same time, that Queen's companion gains a special gene.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Presently, there is an entity on the surface attempting to create a Queen using Nikkes.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I am to prepare a powerful Nikke that will attract that entity's attention, and cause her to become a Queen.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Additionally, I am to prepare a companion for that Nikke in which the other gene can be activated.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That companion must be a bearer of Vapaus.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This will lead to the mutual destruction of the Queen Nikke and her companion.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Should this plan succeed, the Queen will be permanently annihilated,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: and a new Queen will never arise again.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Is this correct?

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... It is so.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: I understand this to be a tedious difficulty. The requisites are manifold.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: A Vapaus bearer to become the companion of a Nikke powerful enough to be a Queen...

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... I myself proposed it, and yet methinks it is preposterous.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: There are currently no individuals in the Ark who satisfy these conditions.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... 'Tis no wonder. I prithee, hold the course and seek yet further—

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: However, they can be made.

lines.speaker: nayuta_n
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Such individuals can be made.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Two projects are currently being conducted in the Ark with the utmost secrecy.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: By using those projects,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: the accomplishment of your objective should not be impossible.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... In other words, your means of securing a powerful Nikke is...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: the Silver Gun Squad.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is correct. It was fortunate.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: There are plenty of other remarkable Nikkes out there, though.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It is true that there are a number of powerful Nikkes, but they are in key combat roles responsible for the Ark's defense.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Your project was the most suitable in multiple different respects.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: And I am essentially turning Marian over to someone or thing that I don't even know, so that she can become a Queen.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The elimination of the Queen.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is the objective on which your project has had a profound influence.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You can achieve a far greater feat than your original objective.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: And it would seem that is the reason you have not shown any reaction to this information.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: So the bearer of Vapaus, the one who will become the companion...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: That's No. 7.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Do you know of Project A.D.?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Vapaus was a lost technology,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: a mystery that even V.T.C. was unable to restore.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: However, it was discovered in Andersen, the commander of the Goddess Squad, during Operation Ark Guardian, in which the Ark was sealed.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: During the operation, Andersen fell into a coma. An attempt was made to extract Vapaus from him in order to mass-produce and weaponize it,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: but all recipients of the Vapaus transplant perished.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I'm guessing an ordinary human body rejects it.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Not just anyone would be compatible with something like that.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: So V.T.C. decided to create duplicates of Andersen. Clones.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Project Andersen Duplicate...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The task of cloning Andersen was beset with numerous difficulties.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: None of the clones could withstand the Vapaus.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This was because Andersen's physical capabilities had transcended those of a human.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: To cite a report written by one of V.T.C.'s researchers: "It's as if he's a hero born to save the world."

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Particularly exceptional was his natural regenerative ability.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: While it is typical for cells to collapse the moment Vapaus replaces the blood,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Andersen was offsetting that side effect with his natural regeneration.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The project shifted in the direction of maximizing that regenerative ability.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Research progressed rapidly. Of course, it also resulted in countless corpses.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The clones created at that time were enough to fully sustain the Ark's energy demands on their own.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... That repulsive, oversized core. A monster that devours people.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Later, those clones acting as fuel would be replaced wholly by the commander-in-chief alone.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... The commander-in-chief?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Thereafter, just as the project neared completion,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: V.T.C. was destroyed.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: From my perspective, it was the perfect opportunity.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I seized full control of the project.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Subsequently, Project A.D. was transferred to M.M.R.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Progress slowed, but the direction no longer relied on sheer chance.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Slowly but steadily, the project advanced,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: producing incremental results,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: until seven clones were completed.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: With the Vapaus in their bodies,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: these clones would become the Queen's companion.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The completed clones were experimented on as they grew from infancy to their mid-twenties within the research lab.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I judge that you are well aware of what kind of research lab that was.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: After completing their growth, the clones enrolled in an elite course in the military academy.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Hah, an "elite" course. That place is just a training school for idiots.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: ... I do not completely disagree.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Following graduation from the academy, the clones enter a comatose state,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: allowing them to be taken out and used when required.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Commanders are convenient in many respects.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... You can reproduce as many of the clones as you want, can't you?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes. There are only seven types, but reproduction is possible.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Records of their growth until their physical prime are kept at the lab, so they can be reproduced at that age whenever desired.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Why was No. 7 the only one reproduced?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: He produced the best results when accompanying the Maria-model Nikke,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: and I judged there to be a clear possibility for him to become the Maria-model Nikke's companion.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I do not understand such emotions,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: but when considering the Maria-model Nikke's expressions and manner of speaking,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I concluded she was showing the early signs of love.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I then judged that the continuity of No. 7's memory was advantageous for inducing that emotion,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: and thus employed the use of an external device's NIMPH.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... If Marian becomes a Queen, and No. 7 gets that gene,

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: and they meet each other...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: they'll both be destroyed, and a Queen will never be born again?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: If they fall in love with each other, they both die.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: That's awful.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: That's just awful.
